kjv: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

lines.say: Lying awake tonight? Use the time this way.
When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches. Psalm sixty three, verse six.
lines.big: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

lines.say: If you can't sleep, think on him instead of the problem.
lines.big: If you can't sleep, think on him instead of the problem.

lines.say: Lord, I'll remember you on my bed tonight. Give me rest. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 57 through 78, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
